blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Intelligent grading and automated scoring technologies constitute critical infrastructure for smart education. However, existing document parsing and handwriting recognition benchmarks are predominantly designed for well-structured printed documents or isolated mathematical expressions, lacking datasets that capture the complex characteristics inherent to student answer sheets, including multi-line derivation processes, heterogeneous mixtures of text and mathematical formulae, and noise artifacts such as strikethroughs. To address this gap, we introduce HANS, the first dataset explicitly constructed for real-world educational scenarios, encompassing mathematical expressions, natural language text, hand-drawn tables, and diverse noise patterns including corrections and deletions, accompanied by fine-grained annotations that establish a reliable foundation for robust recognition research. Building upon HANS, we propose NA-GOT, an end-to-end framework that achieves two-stage noise suppression through a lightweight noise suppression module operating at the feature level, complemented by a noiseaware attention mechanism incorporated into the decoding stage. Experimental results demonstrate that HANS poses substantial challenges to existing methods, while NA-GOT achieves significant improvements in both accuracy and stability for answer process recognition. The dataset will be made publicly available upon publication.
blocks.zh: 智能分级和自动评分技术是智能教育的关键基础设施。 然而,现有的文件解析和笔迹识别基准主要是为结构完善的印刷文件或孤立的数学表达式设计的,缺乏能够反映学生答题表内在的复杂特征的数据集,包括多行推导过程,文字和数学公式的异样混合物,以及噪声文物,如罢课. 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了HANS,这是第一个为现实世界的教育情景而明确构建的数据集,包括数学表达、自然语言文本、手绘表格以及各种噪音模式,包括校正和删除,并附有精细的说明,为有力的识别研究奠定可靠的基础。 在HANS的基础上,我们提议NA-GOT,一种端到端的框架,通过在特征一级运行的轻量级噪声抑制模块实现两阶段噪声抑制,并辅之以纳入解码阶段的噪声感应注意机制. 实验结果表明,HANS对现有方法构成重大挑战,而NA-GOT在准确性和稳定性方面对答案过程识别都取得了显著改善。 数据集将在公布后公布。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Intelligent grading and automated scoring technologies are increasingly emerging as pivotal driving forces in the advancement of smart education. In contrast to outcome-oriented evaluation paradigms that focus exclusively on final answers, modern pedagogical practice, particularly in mathematics education, places greater emphasis on understanding and diagnosing students’ problem-solving thought processes. This demands that intelligent systems be capable of recognizing the derivation steps and natural language explanations written by students on answer sheets, thereby enabling step-wise scoring, error cause analysis, and personalized feedback. Consequently, the accurate recognition of students’ handwritten problem-solving processes constitutes a critical component of intelligent grading systems, as its accuracy and robustness directly determine the viability of downstream scoring and diagnostic tasks.
blocks.zh: 智能分级和自动分分技术正日益成为推动智能教育进步的关键动力。 与完全侧重于最终答案的注重成果的评价范式不同,现代教学实践,特别是在数学教育中,更加强调理解和诊断学生解决问题的思想过程。 这就要求智能系统能够识别学生在答题单上所写的衍生步骤和自然语言解释,从而能够进行相向分数,出错引起分析,以及个性化反馈. 因此,准确认识学生的手写问题解决过程是智能分级系统的重要组成部分,因为它的准确性和稳健性直接决定了下游分数和诊断任务的可行性。

blocks.en: Recent years have witnessed substantial progress in document parsing and handwriting recognition. Document parsing methods are predominantly designed for well-structured printed documents, with representative approaches including multi-stage pipeline [ 8 ] processing and end-to-end vision-language models [ 15 , 16 , 10 , 23 , 20 ] , exemplified by benchmark datasets such as OmniDocBench [ 13 ] and FOX [ 11 ] . Concurrently, research on handwriting recognition using classical benchmarks — including IAM [ 12 ] , CROHME [ 24 ] , and ICDAR Math — has driven an architectural evolution from CNN and RNN-CTC paradigms toward Transformer-based [ 17 ] encoders with Seq2Seq decoders and unified vision-language modeling frameworks.
blocks.zh: 近年来,在文件解析和笔迹识别方面取得了重大进展。 文件解析方法主要是为结构完善的印刷文件所设计的,具有代表性的方法包括多阶段管道[8]处理和端到端的视觉语言模型[15,16,10,23,20],以基准数据集为例,如OmniDoc Bench [13]和FOX [11]. 同时,利用古典基准——包括IAM[12]、CROHME[24]和ICDAR Math——进行笔迹识别研究,推动了从CNN和RNN-CTC范式到以变形器为基础的[17]编码器和Seq2Seq解码器以及统一的视觉语言模型框架的建筑演变。

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Illustration of representative characteristics of the HANS dataset. HANS is a real-world student handwritten mathematics answer sheet dataset, encompassing the dual challenges of complex formula-text interleaving (blue bounding boxes) and correction noise artifacts (red bounding boxes).
blocks.zh: 图1:HANS数据集代表性特征图示. HANS是一款现实世界的学生手写数学答题表数据集,包含复杂的公式-文本互通(蓝边框)和校正噪声文物(红边框)的双重挑战.

blocks.en: Nevertheless, existing benchmarks exhibit several critical limitations. 1) Prevailing datasets predominantly focus on printed academic documents, neglecting real-world handwritten document types such as student answer sheets. 2) There is a systematic absence of research on handwriting noise: most benchmarks assume high document quality and lack systematic annotation and targeted evaluation of common noise artifacts such as strikethroughs, erasures, and overwriting. 3) Existing handwriting datasets are confined to either pure text lines or isolated mathematical expressions; in particular, handwritten mathematical expression recognition has largely been restricted to single-line expressions, with limited investigation into continuous multi-line writing scenarios involving interleaved text and formulae.
blocks.zh: 然而,现有的基准显示出若干关键的局限性。 1) 常用数据集主要以印刷的学术文件为主,忽略了学生答题单等现实世界手写文件类型. 2)对笔迹噪声有系统缺乏研究:大多数基准假设文件质量高并缺乏对常见噪声文物如出击道,去除和覆写等的系统注释和定向评价. 3)现存的笔迹数据集被限制在纯文本行或被孤立的数学表达;特别是手写数学表达式的识别基本上仅限于单行表达,对涉及互出文本和公式的连续多行写作方案的调查有限.

blocks.en: To address these limitations, we introduce HANS, the first dataset explicitly constructed for real-world educational scenarios. HANS is sourced from scanned student answer sheets collected during eighth-grade mathematics quality assessment examinations conducted over three semesters in a municipal school district, specifically from the open-ended mathematical problem-solving sections. To protect student privacy, all personally identifiable information was cropped prior to data release and use. Unlike prior datasets comprising pure text or isolated formulae, the student problem-solving processes in HANS encompass mathematical expressions, natural language text, hand-drawn tables, and manual strikethroughs, faithfully reflecting the typical interplay between mixed handwriting and structured writing characteristic of authentic examination contexts, as shown in Fig. 1 . More critically, we provide fine-grained annotations across distinct writing modalities within the problem-solving process, including content-level annotations for expressions, text, and tables, as well as spatial annotations for noise elements such as strikethroughs and deletions. These annotations furnish a supervisory foundation for explicitly distinguishing noise from valid handwriting, thereby supporting subsequent robust modeling and analysis.
blocks.zh: 为了消除这些局限性,我们引入了HANS,这是第一套专门为现实世界教育情景而构建的数据集. HANS来源于在市一校区进行的为期三个学期的八年级数学质量评估考试期间所收集的扫描学生答题表,具体来自开放式数学问题解答科. 为了保护学生的隐私,在数据发布和使用之前,所有个人可识别的信息都被整理好。 与以前由纯文本或孤立公式组成的数据集不同,HANS中的学生问题解答过程包括数学表达式,自然语言文本,手绘表,以及人工切换等,忠实地反映了真实考试背景的混合笔迹和结构化写作特征之间的典型相互作用,如图1所显示. 更关键的是,我们在解决问题的过程中提供了各种不同写作方式的精细说明,包括表达、文本和表格的内容级别说明,以及对噪声元素的空间说明,如断接和删除。 这些说明为明确区分噪声与有效笔迹提供了监督基础,从而支持随后的强力建模和分析.

blocks.en: Building upon the noise annotations provided by HANS, we further propose NA-GOT, an end-to-end noise-aware recognition framework extending the GOT [ 21 ] architecture. The proposed framework suppresses noise interference through a two-stage mechanism. In the first stage, we design a Lightweight Noise Suppression Module (LNSM) that attenuates noise at the feature level. In the second stage, we introduce a noise-aware attention mechanism that reduces attention weights assigned to noise-bearing regions via learned noise bias terms. Experimental results demonstrate that incorporating the noise-aware mechanism yields significant improvements in both recognition accuracy and output stability for answer sheet problem-solving process recognition.
blocks.zh: 根据HANS提供的噪声说明,我们进一步提议NA-GOT,一个端到端噪声识别框架,扩展GOT[21]架构. 拟议框架通过两阶段机制来抑制噪音干扰。 在第一阶段,我们设计了一个轻量级噪声抑制模块(LNSM)来减轻地物层面的噪音. 在第二阶段,我们引入了注意噪声的机制,通过学到的噪声偏差术语来降低注意分量分配给有噪声区域. 实验结果表明,采用噪音感知机制可大大提高识别准确度和结果稳定性,从而可以识别答案表解决问题的过程。

blocks.en: In summary, the contributions of this paper are as follows:
blocks.zh: 概括地说,本文件的贡献如下:

blocks.en: 1. We construct HANS, a real-world educational answer sheet dataset encompassing mixed handwritten problem-solving processes with heterogeneous content types including mathematical expressions, natural language text, and tables. Fine-grained annotations are provided, with particular emphasis on spatial bounding box annotations for real-world noise artifacts such as strikethroughs and deletions, establishing a foundation for robust recognition research.
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 我们构建了HANS,一个现实世界的教育问答表数据集,包含混合的手写解决问题的过程,内容类型多样,包括数学表达、自然语言文本和表格。 提供了精细说明,特别强调了对真实世界噪声文物如出击和删除的空间约束框说明,为扎实的识别研究打下基础.

blocks.en: 2. We propose NA-GOT, an end-to-end noise-aware recognition framework that achieves two-stage noise suppression through a Lightweight Noise Suppression Module(LNSM) and a noise-aware attention mechanism.
blocks.zh: 2. 联合国 我们提议NA-GOT,一个端到端的噪声识别框架,通过轻量级噪声抑制模块(LNSM)和噪声认知关注机制实现两级噪声抑制.

blocks.en: 3. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that the HANS dataset presents substantial challenges to current state-of-the-art methods, and validate that the proposed approach significantly outperforms existing methods.
blocks.zh: 3个 广泛的实验结果表明,HANS数据集对目前最先进的方法构成重大挑战,并证实拟议方法大大超过现有方法。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Document Parsing and Handwriting Recognition Datasets
blocks.zh: 2.1 文档解析和手写识别数据集

blocks.en: In the domain of document parsing, datasets such as DocLayNet [ 14 ] and OmniDocBench [ 13 ] provide important benchmarks for document layout segmentation and multi-task learning, with particular significance for layout element detection and segmentation. Concurrently, datasets including FUNSD [ 7 ] and FOX have advanced the parsing of form and handwritten documents, encompassing diverse components such as tables, text, and formulae while extending support to more complex document structures. The data distributions of these benchmarks are predominantly composed of printed text, with relatively limited representation of handwritten content, and systematic investigation of noise-related challenges remains largely absent. Existing handwriting recognition datasets, such as IAM, CROHME, and MathWriting [ 5 ] , primarily focus on offline handwriting recognition and mathematical formula transcription tasks. Although substantial progress has been achieved in handwritten text and mathematical expression recognition, these datasets continue to suffer from limited diversity in writing modalities.
blocks.zh: 在文档解析领域,DocLayNet [14]和OmniDoc Bench [13]等数据集为文档布局分解和多任务学习提供了重要基准,对布局元素检测和分解具有特别重要的意义. 同时,包括FUNSD[7]和FOX在内的数据集推进了形式和手写文档的解析,包括表格、文本和公式等不同组成部分,同时向更复杂的文档结构提供支持。 这些基准的数据分配主要由印刷文本组成,手写内容的表述相对有限,对噪音相关挑战的系统调查仍然基本上缺乏. 现存的笔迹识别数据集,如IAM,CROHME,和MathWriting[5],主要侧重于线下笔迹识别和数学公式转录任务. 尽管在手写文字和数学表达识别方面已经取得了实质性的进展,但这些数据集在写作方式上仍然受到有限的多样性.

blocks.en: 2.2 Document Parsing and Handwriting Recognition Models
blocks.zh: 2.2 文档解析和手写识别模型

blocks.en: In the area of generative document understanding, models such as Nougat [ 2 ] and GOT-OCR2.0 realize end-to-end conversion from document images to structured text via visual Transformer architectures, supporting joint modeling of heterogeneous content types. LayoutLM [ 25 ] achieves strong performance through joint modeling of layout and content by integrating visual and textual information within a unified framework. In the field of handwriting recognition, TrOCR [ 9 ] adopts an architecture comprising an image Transformer encoder coupled with a text Transformer decoder, enabling efficient end-to-end handwritten text transcription. In the domain of handwritten mathematical expression recognition, works such as TAMER introduce tree-structure-aware modules to jointly optimize sequence prediction and tree structure prediction tasks, thereby improving model generalization over complex mathematical expression structures and demonstrating strong adaptability — particularly for the recognition of intricate formulae and expressions.
blocks.zh: 在基因文件理解领域,Nougat [2]和Got-OCR2.0等模型通过视觉变形器架构实现从文档图像到结构化文本的端到端转换,支持对不同内容类型的联合建模. 布局LM[25]通过将视觉和文字信息整合到一个统一的框架中,对布局和内容进行联合模型化,实现强效. 在笔迹识别领域,TrOCR [9]采用由图像变形器编码器和文本变形器解码器组成的架构,使端到端的手写文本能高效地被复制. 在手写数学表达识别领域,TAMER等作品引入了树-结构-意识模块来联合优化序列预测和树结构预测任务,从而改进了模型泛化于复杂的数学表达结构,并表现出了强烈的适应性——特别是用于识别复杂的公式和表达.

blocks.en: Despite the remarkable progress achieved in existing document parsing and handwriting recognition techniques, current methodologies remain inadequate in addressing the noise-corrupted and structurally complex handwriting characteristics inherent to educational answer sheets. Consequently, future research should build upon existing datasets and methods to develop more specialized datasets and more adaptive model frameworks, with the aim of enhancing robustness and accuracy in the educational answer sheet recognition task.
blocks.zh: 尽管现有文件解析和笔迹识别技术取得了显著进展,但目前的方法仍然不足以解决教育问答表固有的噪音腐蚀和结构复杂的笔迹特征。 因此,今后的研究应当以现有数据集和方法为基础,开发更专门的数据集和更具适应性的模型框架,目的是提高教育问答表识别任务的力度和准确性。

blocks.en: 3 HANS Dataset
blocks.zh: 3个HANS数据集

blocks.en: 3.1 Dataset Construction and Statistics
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集建设和统计

blocks.en: We construct HANS, a dataset designed for real-world educational answer sheet scenarios. The data are sourced from eighth-grade mathematics quality assessment examinations conducted over three semesters in a municipal middle school district in China, specifically from the open-ended problem-solving sections comprising six mathematical questions per examination, drawn from scanned student answer sheets, as shown in Tab. 1 . The dataset contains 5,213 answer question images, covering 745 students across 18 distinct problem types. To protect student privacy, all personally identifiable information was cropped prior to data release and use.
blocks.zh: 我们构建HANS,一个为现实世界教育答案表情景设计的数据集. 数据来源于中国一个市中区三个学期的八年级数学质量评估考试,具体来说,来自由每个考试六个数学问题组成的开放式问题解决科,取自扫描的学生答题表,如Tab所示。 1. 数据集包含5,213个回答问题图像,涵盖18个不同问题类型的745名学生。 为了保护学生的隐私,在数据发布和使用之前,所有个人可识别的信息都被整理好。

blocks.en: Table 1 : Comparison of HANS against existing datasets.HS denotes the number of handwritten samples,and Level indicates the sample granularity(page or line). HME, HT, and NA indicate the presence of handwritten mathematical expressions,handwritten text, and noise annotations,respectively.
blocks.zh: 表1:HANS与现有数据集的比较. HS表示手写样品的数量,而Level表示样品颗粒性(页或行). HME, HT,和NA分别表示手写数学表达式,手写文字,和噪声说明的存在.

blocks.en: The writing patterns in HANS exhibit considerable complexity. Within a single page, natural language explanations and mathematical expressions frequently appear in interleaved configurations, accompanied by extensive multi-line derivation steps, chains of equations, and cross-line intermediate results that collectively encode rich procedural information. The mathematical expressions themselves present high structural complexity, commonly featuring fractions, radicals, superscripts and subscripts, nested parentheses, and diverse geometric and logical symbols, further compounding the difficulty of symbol-level accurate transcription and structural consistency constraints. In addition, HANS contains a non-trivial proportion of hand-drawn tables, whose cells typically contain both natural language and mathematical content simultaneously, substantially increasing the coupling between structural layout recognition and content transcription. Furthermore, the answer sheets exhibit pervasive real-world noise and correction behaviors characteristic of authentic examination contexts, including erasures, strikethroughs, and overwriting, which introduce stroke discontinuities, stroke superposition, local occlusion, and structural degradation. These artifacts result in severe spatial entanglement between valid handwriting and noise traces, significantly elevating the uncertainty and difficulty faced by recognition models.
blocks.zh: HANS的写作模式显示出相当的复杂性. 在一页内,自然语言解释和数学表达经常出现于相接的配置中,并伴有广泛的多行衍生步骤,等式链和跨行中间结果,这些结果共同编码了丰富的程序信息. 数学表达本身呈现出高结构复杂性,通常以分数,基数,上标和下标为特征,嵌入括号,并有多种几何和逻辑符号,使符号级准确的抄录和结构一致性限制的难度进一步复杂化. 此外,HANS还包含了手绘表格的非三角比例,其单元格通常同时包含自然语言和数学内容,大大增加了结构布局识别和内容抄录之间的耦合. 此外,答题单还显示了真实世界中普遍存在的噪音和校正行为,表现为真实的检查背景,包括去除震荡、断层和覆盖,从而引入了中风断续性、中风叠加、局部隔离和结构退化。 这些文物导致有效笔迹和噪音痕迹之间的严重空间缠绕,大大提高了识别模型面临的不确定性和困难.

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Characteristics of the HANS annotated dataset. Each sample in the dataset is annotated with both the complete problem-solving process transcription and the corresponding correction noise regions. Blue bounding boxes denote the annotation of interleaved mathematical expressions and natural language text, while red bounding boxes indicate the spatial annotations of correction noise artifacts.
blocks.zh: 图2:HANS注释数据集的特征. 数据集中的每个样本都附有完整的解决问题过程转录和相应的校正噪声区域注释. 蓝边框表示对相接的数学表达和自然语言文字的注释,而红边框则表示校正噪声文物的空间注释.

blocks.en: 3.2 Annotation Details
blocks.zh: 3.2 注释细节

blocks.en: Unlike benchmarks that provide only final answer transcriptions or annotations for isolated formulae, we provide annotations more closely aligned with the requirements of automated grading. The fundamental sample unit of the dataset is defined as the answer region image corresponding to each open-ended problem, with each sample containing two categories of annotations: (1) problem-solving process recognition annotations, and (2) non-semantic noise region annotations for erasures and strikethroughs. Full details are illustrated in Fig. 2 .
blocks.zh: 与仅为孤立公式提供最后回答抄录或说明的基准不同,我们提供的说明更符合自动化分级的要求。 数据集的基本取样单位被定义为每个可打开的问题对应的解答区域图像,每个取样包含两类说明:(1)解决问题过程识别说明;(2)除去和出击的非语义噪声区域说明. 详细情况见图2。

blocks.en: Problem-Solving Process Recognition Annotations
blocks.zh: 解决问题进程识别说明

blocks.en: Each sample is provided with a recognition transcription corresponding to the complete problem-solving process visible in the image; content that has been deleted by the student is excluded from the final transcription. In terms of structural representation, the problem-solving process is segmented according to the semantic information of each handwritten line, strictly preserving the original line breaks as written. The logical ordering between lines is inferred from handwriting layout conventions, with line break symbols employed to denote logical sequencing.
blocks.zh: 每个样本都提供对应图像所可见的完整解决问题过程的识别转录;被学生删除的内容从最终转录中排除. 在结构表示方面,问题解析过程按照每条手写行的语义信息进行分解,严格保留了正本行间断. 从笔迹布局惯例推断出行与行之间的逻辑顺序,并使用分行符号表示逻辑顺序.

blocks.en: Noise Region Detection Annotations
blocks.zh: 噪音区域检测说明

blocks.en:
For images containing noise, we provide pixel-level annotation files for noise regions, stored in JSON format. All noise instances within an image are uniformly assigned the label noise and are permitted to adopt one of two geometric annotation structures: block-level erasures or strikethroughs are annotated using rectangle, defined by two diagonal corner coordinates, while irregularly shaped corrections or localized ink clusters are annotated using polygon, defined by a closed multi-point contour. In cases where noise regions partially overlap with valid content, conservative boundary fitting is applied to minimize erroneous coverage of effective derivation areas.
For strikethrough scenarios, annotations primarily delineate the extent of visible occlusion caused by deletion strokes. For overwriting scenarios, annotations encompass both the discarded content and the superimposed strokes, while endeavoring to preserve the final legible and correct writing. For erasure scenarios, annotations cover both erasure residuals and regions rendered illegible by the erasing action.
blocks.zh:
对于包含噪声的图像,我们为噪声区域提供像素级注释文件,以JSON格式存储. 图像中的所有噪声事件均被统一指定为标签噪声,并允许采用两个几何注释结构中的一个: 块级去除或出击通路被使用矩形来注释,由两个对角坐标来定义,而不规则形状的校正或本地化的墨子集群则使用多边形来注释,由闭合多点轮廓来定义. 如果噪音区域与有效内容部分相重叠,则采用保守的边界接合方式来尽量减少对有效衍生区域的错误覆盖。
对于切换情景,说明主要描述被删除中风所引起可见的隔离程度. 对于覆写情景,说明既包括被丢弃的内容,也包括被叠加的中风,同时努力保留最终可辨别和正确的写作. 对于去除假想,说明既包括去除后遗症,也包括被去除后所看不到的区域。

blocks.en: 3.3 Annotation Pipeline
blocks.zh: 3.3 注解管道

blocks.en: To ensure both annotation quality and operational efficiency, we design a three-stage pipeline for the HANS annotation task, comprising automatic pre-annotation, annotator correction, and expert quality inspection.
blocks.zh: 为了确保注释质量和操作效率,我们为HANS注释任务设计了三阶段管道,包括自动预先注释、注释校正和专家质量检查。

blocks.en: Automatic pre-annotation . We employ state-of-the-art detection and recognition models to generate pre-annotations for both noise region detection and problem-solving process transcription. Specifically, YOLOv8 [ 6 ] is adopted for the automatic localization of student correction regions, while DeepSeek-OCR [ 22 ] is employed for preliminary content recognition of answer sheets, encompassing annotations for text, mathematical expressions, and tables.
blocks.zh: 自动预注 。 我们采用最先进的检测和识别模式,为噪音区域检测和解决问题过程记录提供预先说明。 具体来说,YOLOv8 [6]是用于学生校正区域自动本地化的,而DeepSeek-OCR [22]则用于对答题表的初步内容识别,包括文本、数学表达和表格的说明。

blocks.en: Annotator correction . Following automatic pre-annotation, human annotators systematically revise the initial annotation results. For student correction regions, annotators identify and supplement any missed noise areas, and refine the bounding box boundaries to more precisely conform to the extents of the correction artifacts. Each character is individually verified to ensure transcription accuracy. With respect to the overall problem-solving process, annotators perform character-level inspection and correction of the preliminary recognition drafts, ensuring the accurate representation of text, mathematical symbols, and their structural relationships. Omitted content is supplemented where necessary, and output formatting is standardized to satisfy the requirements of subsequent model training and evaluation.
blocks.zh: 注释者更正. 在自动预注后,人类注释者系统修改了初始的注释结果. 对于学生校正区域,注释者确定并补充任何缺失的噪声区域,并更精确地将相接的框框界限与校正文物的范围相匹配. 每个字符都经过单独核查,以确保抄录准确。 关于解决问题的整个过程,注释员对初步识别草案进行品格水平检查和纠正,确保文本、数学符号及其结构关系的准确表述。 必要时补充了已公布的内容,并标准化了产出格式,以满足随后的示范培训和评价的要求。

blocks.en: Quality inspection . Despite the comprehensive corrections performed by annotators, the structural complexity of mathematical formulae and tables may nonetheless introduce residual errors. Accordingly, domain experts conduct a dedicated quality inspection pass to verify annotation accuracy and ensure consistency across the dataset.
blocks.zh: 质检. 尽管注释者作了全面的校正,数学公式和表格的结构复杂性仍可能带来剩余错误。 因此,域专家进行一次专门的质量检查,以核实注释的准确性并确保各数据集的一致性。

blocks.en: 4 Method
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: We propose NA-GOT, a noise-aware end-to-end answer sheet recognition framework, as illustrated in Fig. 3 , designed to mitigate the interference of real-world noise artifacts, including erasures, strikethroughs, and overwriting on the accurate recognition of valid handwritten characters. Building upon GOT, the proposed framework suppresses noise through a two-stage mechanism. In the first stage, we design a Lightweight Noise Suppression Module (LNSM) that attenuates noise influence at the feature level. In the second stage, we introduce a Noise-aware attention mechanism that reduces attention weights assigned to noise-bearing regions via learned noise bias terms. Specifically, the input image is first processed by a visual encoder to extract patch-level features, while a mask matrix generated from noise annotations provides noise-aware supervision signals during training. The noise-aware module performs weighted suppression of features according to the predicted noise probabilities, and subsequently modulates the decoder’s attention distribution to direct the model’s focus toward valid handwriting regions. The resulting visual features are then projected via a linear layer and fed into the decoder, which generates the final Markdown-formatted output, achieving complete transcription of natural language text, mathematical formulae, and step-by-step derivations.
blocks.zh: 我们提议NA-GOT(噪音感知端到端的答题识别框架),如图3所示,旨在减轻现实世界噪声文物的干扰,包括去除震荡,出击,并覆盖对有效手写字符的准确识别. 在GOT的基础上,拟议的框架通过两个阶段机制来抑制噪音。 在第一阶段,我们设计了轻量级噪声抑制模块(LNSM)来减轻地物层面的噪声影响. 在第二阶段,我们引入了一种噪音感知关注机制,通过学到的噪声偏差术语来降低噪声产生区域的注意力分量. 具体而言,输入图像首先由可视编码器处理以提取补丁级特征,而由噪声说明所生成的口罩矩阵则在训练期间提供噪声感知监督信号. 噪声感知模块根据预测的噪声概率对特征进行加权压制,并随后将解码器的注意力分布来引导模型的焦点转向有效的笔迹区域. 由此产生的视觉特征随后通过线性地层被投射出并被输入解码器中,解码器产生最终的Markdown-formated输出,实现自然语言文本的完整转录,数学公式,并分步产生.

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Overall architecture of the NA-GOT framework.
blocks.zh: 图3:NA-GOT框架的总体结构。

blocks.en: 4.1 Lightweight Noise Suppression Module
blocks.zh: 4.1 轻量级噪声抑制模块

blocks.en: We first construct patch-level supervision signals aligned with the visual patch tokens from the noise annotations. Specifically, for each image, all annotations are first converted into a binary pixel mask matrix M M according to the original image resolution. To maintain consistency with the patch token layout of the GOT visual encoder, M M is uniformly resized to a resolution of 1024×1024, followed by 16×16 average pooling to compute the noise occupancy ratio over the patch grid. The resulting grid is subsequently flattened into patch-level noise labels m g ​ t m^{g}t in one-to-one correspondence with the visual tokens, where each entry in m g ​ t m^{g}t represents the proportion of noise pixels within the corresponding patch.
blocks.zh: 我们首先从噪声说明中 构建与视觉补丁符号一致的 补丁级监督信号 具体来说,对于每个图像,所有注释首先会被按照原始图像分辨率转换为二进制像素口罩矩阵M M. 为了与Got视觉编码器的补丁符号布局保持一致,M M被统一调整为分辨率为1024×1024,再由16×16平均集合来计算补丁网格上噪声占用率. 由此产生的网格随后被平整为与视觉符号的一对一通信中的补丁级噪声标记mg t m^{g}t,其中每个条目以mg t m^{g}t表示相应补丁内噪声像素的比例.

blocks.en: We takes the patch-level noise labels m g ​ t m^{g}t and the output features V V of the visual encoder as inputs to the Noise Mask Head (NMH), which determines whether each patch constitutes a noise patch. Concretely, NMH employs a two-layer MLP to predict a noise confidence score p p for each patch token:
blocks.zh: 我们把补丁级噪声标签 mg t m^{g}t 和视觉编码器的输出特征 V 作为输入到噪声遮罩头(NMH),它决定了每个补丁是否构成噪声补丁. NMH使用两层MLP来预测每个补丁符号p的噪声自信分数:

blocks.en: p = σ ​ ( MLP ​ ( V ) ) p=\sigma(\text{MLP}(V))
blocks.zh: p = \ (MLP (V)) p =\ sigma (\text{MLP} (V))

blocks.en: This design enables the model to adaptively predict noise distributions during inference without relying on manual annotations or additional noise inputs, while simultaneously providing stable noise priors for subsequent token gating and the decoder’s noise-aware attention bias, thereby enhancing the robustness of downstream sequence generation.
blocks.zh: 这种设计使模型能够在推论中适应性地预测噪声分布,而无需依赖手动说明或额外的噪声输入,同时为后续的标语标语提供稳定的噪声前兆和解码器的噪声-意识注意偏差,从而增强下游序列生成的稳健性.

blocks.en: Leveraging the obtained noise confidence scores p p , we further suppress the representational magnitude of noise tokens at the visual token level. Specifically, the noise confidence scores p are mapped to gating coefficients, which are applied to scale the visual tokens on a per-token basis:
blocks.zh: 利用得到的噪声自信分数 p,我们进一步抑制了在视觉噪声分数层次的噪声分数。 具体地说,噪声置信分数p被映射成指向分数,这些分数被应用到每个分数的可视化符号上:

blocks.en: V ~ = V ⊙ ( 1 − α ⋅ p ) \tilde{V}=V\odot\bigl(1-\alpha\cdot p\bigr)
blocks.zh: V ~ = V ~ (1 – α → p )\tilde{ V\\ odot\ bigl (1-\ alpha\ cdot p\bigr)

blocks.en: where ⊙ \odot denotes element-wise multiplication, and α \alpha is a hyperparameter controlling the gating strength.
blocks.zh: 其中\\odot表示元素相乘,而α\alpha是一个超参数,控制了取入强度.

blocks.en: 4.2 Weighted Attention Correction
blocks.zh: 4.2 重心矫正

blocks.en: While LNSM modulates the representational magnitude of visual tokens, the decoder may nevertheless assign substantial attention weights to noise tokens. Since NA-GOT concatenates visual patch tokens and text tokens into a unified sequence, cross-modal alignment occurs within the decoder. To suppress the interference of noise visual tokens on the generation process, Weighted Attention Correction (WAC) introduces a negative bias derived from the noise probabilities p output by NMH into the decoder’s self-attention layers:
blocks.zh: 虽然LNSM调制了视觉信使的表示分量,但解码器可能会给噪声信使分配大量的注意力分量. 由于NA-GOT将可视补丁符号和文本符号组合成一个统一的序列,因此在解码器内会发生跨模式对接. 为了抑制噪声视觉符号对生成过程的干扰,Weighted Control(WAC)引入了由NMH的噪声概率p输出产生的负面偏差入解码器自觉层:

blocks.en: b = − β ⋅ p b=-\beta\cdot p
blocks.zh: b = - β p = -\ beta\ cdot p

blocks.en: where b b denotes the bias term and β \beta is a hyperparameter controlling the penalty strength. A higher noise probability yields a larger bias, resulting in a lower attention weight for the corresponding patch following the softmax operation.
blocks.zh: b 表示偏差的名词,而β\β是控制惩罚强度的超参数。 高噪音概率产生较大的偏差,导致软马克斯操作后相应补丁的注意力重量更低.

blocks.en: This mechanism penalizes noise patches during attention computation, directing the decoder’s focus toward valid handwriting regions, thereby improving both the accuracy and structural integrity of the generated Markdown output in complex handwritten answer sheet scenarios.
blocks.zh: 这种机制惩罚了注意力计算过程中的噪声补丁,引导解码器的焦点转向有效的笔迹区域,从而在复杂的手写答录板情景中提高生成的Markdown输出的准确性和结构完整性.

A binary cross-entropy loss with positive sample weighting is applied to compute the noise mask loss L m ​ a ​ s ​ k L_{mask} . Given the input image and the corresponding prompt, the model autoregressively generates the target sequence, with cross-entropy loss computed as the primary recognition loss L o ​ c ​ r L_{ocr} . blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5个实验

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 执行细节

blocks.en: We employ the proposed NA-GOT model for both training and evaluation. For the LNSM, patch-level noise supervision signals are generated from noise annotations during training to supervise the NMH in predicting noise distributions. The key hyperparameters adopted are α \alpha = 0.7 and β \beta = 2.0.
blocks.zh: 我们采用拟议的NA-GOT模式进行培训和评价。 对LNSM来说,补丁级噪声监督信号是在训练中从噪声说明中生成的来监督NMH来预测噪声分布. 采用的关键高参数为α-α=0.7和β-β-β=2.0.

blocks.en: Dataset and Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 数据集和评价计量

blocks.en: We conduct all experiments on the proposed HANS dataset to evaluate whether the proposed method effectively addresses the robustness challenges inherent to answer sheet recognition. The dataset is partitioned into training and test sets at an 8:2 ratio, with samples containing noise regions comprising three-quarters of the training set. Evaluation is performed using sequence alignment metrics commonly adopted in document parsing research, including BLEU, Edit Distance, METEOR, Precision, Recall, and F1-score.
blocks.zh: 我们对提议的HANS数据集进行所有实验,以评估拟议方法是否有效解决了对答表识别固有的强性挑战。 数据集按8:2的比例被分入培训和测试集,包含噪音区域的样本占培训集的四分之三. 评价使用文件解析研究中常用的序列校正度量,包括BLEU、编辑距离、METEOR、精度、召回和F1-分数。

blocks.en: Baselines
blocks.zh: 基线

blocks.en: To comprehensively evaluate the proposed method, we select three categories of representative baselines for comparison: (1) General VLMs: Qwen3-VL [ 1 ] and InternVL3.5 [ 19 ] ; (2) Specialized VLMs: DeepSeek-OCR2, PaddleOCR-VL1.5 [ 3 ] , MinerU2.7.6-VLM [ 18 ] , and GOT; (3) Pipeline Tools: PaddleOCR PP-StructureV3 [ 4 ] and MinerU2.7.6-Pipeline. To provide a rigorous comparison, GOT is additionally fine-tuned on the full HANS training set prior to evaluation, thereby demonstrating the superiority of the proposed approach.
blocks.zh: 为了全面评估拟议方法,我们选择了三类有代表性的基线进行比较: (1)普通VLMs:Quen3-VL [1]和InternVL3.5 [19]; (2)专用VLMs:DeepSeek-OCR2,PaddleOCR-VL1.5 [3],MinerU2.7.6-VLM [18],并Got; (3)管道工具:PaddleOCR PP-Structure V3 [4]和MinerU2.7.6-Pipeline. 为了进行严格的比较,GOT在评价前对HANS的全部培训进行了进一步的微调,从而表明拟议方法的优越性。

blocks.en: 5.2 Comparison to Previous Approaches
blocks.zh: 5.2 与以往办法的比较

blocks.en: We present a comprehensive comparison of NA-GOT against prior methods on the HANS dataset in Tab. 2 , with all baselines organized into three groups by model category. NA-GOT consistently surpasses all baselines across General VLMs, Specialized VLMs, and Pipeline Tools. Pipeline Tools exhibit notably inferior performance on this task, while General VLMs and Specialized VLMs achieve moderate performance. Among these, Qwen3-VL delivers the strongest results, indicating that powerful general-purpose VLMs possess considerable document understanding and generation capabilities, yet remain susceptible to noise interference in the challenging noisy answer sheet scenario. GOT transferred directly to this dataset yields relatively low performance, suggesting a substantial domain shift between this task distribution and the original training data — particularly with respect to noise patterns and the heterogeneous output requirements imposed by interleaved formula-text handwriting. This further underscores the value of HANS in filling a critical data gap in the document parsing domain. In contrast, GOT fine-tuned on HANS achieves significant performance gains, validating the effectiveness of our annotations in enabling the model to rapidly adapt to the target data distribution. Compared to the fine-tuned GOT baseline, our proposed method achieves consistent improvements across all evaluation metrics, with particularly pronounced gains on heavily noisy samples. These results demonstrate that the proposed Lightweight Noise Suppression Module(LNSM) effectively learns to extract noise-invariant features, while the Noise-aware attention mechanism penalizes noise-bearing positions at the attention layer, thereby mitigating noise-induced misalignment and repetitive generation.
blocks.zh: 我们全面比较了NA-GOT与Tab的HANS数据集的以往方法。 2,所有基线按模型类别分为三组. NA-GOT始终超过通用甚高频、专用甚高频和管道工具的所有基线。 管道工具在这项工作中表现明显低下,而通用的VLM和专用的VLM则取得了适度的性能. 其中,Qune3-VL能提供最强的结果,表明强大的通用VLM具有相当的文件理解和生成能力,但在具有挑战性的吵闹的答题场景中仍然容易受到噪音干扰. 直接转到这个数据集后,性能相对较低,表明这一任务分布与原始培训数据之间的域位相去甚远,特别是在噪声模式和互出式文字笔迹所施加的不同产出要求方面。 这进一步突出了HANS在填补文档解析域中的关键数据空白方面的价值. 相比之下,对HANS进行微调,取得了显著的绩效收益,验证了我们说明的有效性,使模型能够迅速适应目标数据分布。 与经过微调的GOT基准相比,我们提议的方法在所有评价指标方面都取得了一致的改进,在非常吵闹的样本上取得了特别显著的进展。 这些结果显示,拟议的轻量级噪声抑制模块(LNSM)有效地学会了提取噪声-变异性特征,而噪声-发觉的注意机制则惩罚了注意层有噪声的位置,从而减轻了噪声引起的错位和重复生成.

blocks.en: 5.3 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 5.3 读取研究

blocks.en: We conduct an ablation study by removing individual noise-aware components from the full NA-GOT model to evaluate their respective contributions, as reported in Tab. 3 . The w/o WAC variant achieves a BLEU score of 0.589 and an Edit Distance of 0.314, indicating that the noise prediction and token gating mechanism alone can effectively suppress noise interference at the feature level. The w/o token gating variant yields lower BLEU and F1-score than the w/o WAC variant, suggesting that feature-level token gating contributes more substantially to robust recognition than decoder-level attention correction alone. Nevertheless, both ablated variants underperform the full NA-GOT model. The full model achieves the best overall performance across all evaluation metrics, demonstrating that token gating and WAC provide complementary benefits at the representation and decoding stages, respectively.
blocks.zh: 如Tab所报告,我们通过从NA-GOT模型的完整模型中去除单个有噪声意识的成分,来评估其各自的贡献,从而开展一项消毒研究。 3,w/o WAC变体的BLEU得分为0.589分,编辑距离为0.314分,表明单是噪声预测和象征性的取景机制就可以在地物层面有效抑制噪声干扰. 与W/o WAC变体相比,W/o标志性地标变体的分数比BLEU和F1-分数低,这表明特征级标志性地标的分数单靠解码器级注意力校正更有助于有力的识别。 尽管如此,两个被淡化的变体都未完全实现NA-GOT模型. 整个模式在所有评价衡量标准中都取得了最佳的总体业绩,表明象征性地标定和WAC在代表阶段和编解码阶段分别提供了互补的好处。

blocks.en: Table 3 : Ablation study of token gating and Weighted Attention Correction (WAC) in NA-GOT.
blocks.zh: 表3:NA-GOT中象征性地取出和重心校正(WAC)的读取研究。

blocks.en: 5.4 Hyperparameter experimentation
blocks.zh: 5.4 超参数实验

blocks.en: Furthermore, we conduct ablation experiments on the two key hyperparameters, α \alpha and β \beta . As reported in Tab. 4 , the gating strength coefficient α \alpha is found to exert a significant influence on model performance. When α \alpha = 0.5, noise suppression is insufficient, allowing noise tokens to propagate into the decoder with considerable magnitude, resulting in marginally lower BLEU and F1-score. When α \alpha = 0.9, excessive suppression impairs a portion of valid features, leading to slight degradation in BLEU and METEOR. The model achieves optimal overall performance at α \alpha = 0.7, indicating that moderate representation-level noise suppression effectively reduces noise-induced erroneous generation without sacrificing coverage of critical information.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们还在α-α和β-β-β这两个关键超参数上进行了减速实验。 如塔布所报. 4,发现地标强度系数α-α对模型性能有重大影响. 当α-α = 0.5时,噪声抑制不足,允许噪声信号器向解码器中传播出相当大的分量,导致BLEU和F1-分数略低. 当α-α = 0.9时,过度抑制会损害部分有效特征,导致BLEU和METEOR的轻微降解. 该模型在α-α = 0.7实现最佳整体性能,表明中度代表级噪声抑制能有效减少噪声引起的错误生成而不会牺牲关键信息的覆盖.

blocks.en: The hyperparameter β \beta governs the penalty strength imposed on noise patches at the attention layer, with results reported in Tab. 5 . When β \beta = 1.0, the penalty is insufficient, causing the model to produce erroneous outputs in certain noise-bearing regions. When β \beta = 3.0, the excessively large penalty introduces mild over-suppression, marginally weakening the decoder’s attention allocation toward valid patches. At β \beta = 2.0, the model exhibits a stronger tendency to aggregate information from non-noise regions, yielding optimal performance across all evaluation metrics.
blocks.zh: β\β高参数规范了对注意力层噪声补丁的处罚强度,结果在Tab中报告。 5. 当β\β=1.0时,处罚不足,导致模型在某些有噪声的区域产生出错的输出. 当β\β=3.0时,过大的处罚会引入轻微的过度压抑,略微削弱解码器对有效补丁的注意力分配. 在β\beta = 2.0中,该模型显示出一种更强烈的趋势,即汇集来自非噪声区域的信息,在所有评价指标中产生最佳业绩。

blocks.en: 5.5 Visual Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.5 视觉分析

blocks.en: The recognition results from four models—NA-GOT, Qwen3-VL, DeepSeek-OCR2, and MinerU2.7.6-pipeline—are compared in Figure 4. NA-GOT demonstrates stronger robustness and generation stability in noisy areas, making fewer errors in misinterpreting erasure textures or strikethrough lines as characters or symbols. It maintains a reasonable line-level structure and derivation order.Additionally, NA-GOT shows a higher fidelity to structured formulas, with fractions, parentheses, and equality chains more consistent, and key variables and operators more coherent, thus reducing semantic bias caused by omissions, mistakes, or structural damage.
blocks.zh: 图中比较了四种模型——NA-GOT、Qune3-VL、DeepSeek-OCR2和MinerU 2.7.6-管线。 4. NA-GOT在吵闹地区表现出更强的稳健性和生成稳定性,在将去除纹理或通向线曲误为字符或符号方面少出错误。 它保持合理的行平面结构和起算顺序. 此外,NA-GOT对结构公式的忠诚度更高,分数、括号和平等链更加一致,关键变量和操作符更加一致,从而减少由遗漏、错误或结构损害造成的语义偏差。

blocks.en: In contrast, general multimodal models like Qwen3-VL, although generally readable, are more prone to misreading similar-looking variables and numbers near noise boundaries, and tend to experience local misalignment or omission in complex derivations. Specialized VLMs, such as DeepSeek-OCR2, are more prone to decoding instability or structural misreadings under strong noise conditions. For instance, in the red box, DeepSeek-OCR2 shows noticeable repetitive outputs, rendering the entire derivation unusable. Pipeline methods, such as MinerU2.7.6-pipeline, are more likely to miss content or make incorrect identifications, leading to missing steps, disjointed content, or even unrelated structures being introduced.
blocks.zh: 相形之下,一般的多式模型,如Qune3-VL,虽然一般可以读取,但更容易在噪声边界附近误读相近的变数和数字,并且往往在复杂的衍生物中经历局部的错配或遗漏. 专门的VLM,如DeepSeek-OCR2等在强烈噪声条件下更容易被解码不稳定或结构误读. 例如,在红框中,DeepSeek-OCR2显示出明显的重复输出,使得整个衍生物无法使用. 管道方法,如MinerU2.7.6-管线,更有可能错失内容或作出不正确的识别,导致缺少步骤,内容脱节,甚至不相干的结构被引入.

blocks.en: Overall, this visualization case demonstrates that NA-GOT effectively mitigates the misattention and misalignment issues induced by noise, significantly suppressing the degradation caused by repetitive generation in long sequences. As a result, it provides more stable, structured, and accurate recognition outputs, which are closer to being usable for subsequent automatic grading and diagnosis in real answer sheet scenarios.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,这个可视化案例表明NA-GOT有效缓解了噪音引起的误入和错位问题,并极大地抑制了由长序重复生成所引发的降解. 因此,它提供了更稳定,更有条理,更准确的识别产出,这些产出更接近于在真实的答案表情景中用于随后的自动分级和诊断.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we address the problem of recognizing students’ handwritten problem-solving processes on answer sheets in smart education scenarios. We introduce HANS, the first dataset specifically constructed for this task, encompassing mathematical expressions, natural language text, hand-drawn tables, and diverse noise artifacts including strikethroughs and deletions, with fine-grained annotations that provide a reliable foundation for robust recognition research. Furthermore, we propose NA-GOT, an end-to-end noise-aware recognition framework that achieves two-stage noise suppression through a lightweight noise suppression module and a noise-aware attention mechanism. Experimental results demonstrate that the HANS dataset presents substantial challenges to existing methods, while NA-GOT achieves significant improvements in both recognition accuracy and output stability for problem-solving process transcription, offering an effective solution for handwritten document parsing in real-world educational scenarios.
blocks.zh: 校对:Soup 我们引入了HANS,这是第一个专门为这项任务构建的数据集,包含数学表达,自然语言文本,手绘表,以及各种噪声文物,包括出击和删除,并附有精细的描述,为扎实的识别研究提供可靠的基础. 此外,我们提议NA-GOT,一种端到端的噪声识别框架,通过轻量级噪声抑制模块和噪声认知关注机制实现两级噪声抑制. 实验结果显示,HANS数据集对现有方法构成重大挑战,而NA-GOT在识别准确性和产出稳定性方面对解决问题过程的转录都有了显著改善,为在现实世界教育情景中解析手写文件提供了一个有效的解决方案。
